name: Porvoo refinery outage, six weeks
description: The country's only refinery (Porvoo, Kilpilahti) stops for 42 days after a fire-scale incident; ports keep importing finished fuel at their normal rates and a short burst of hoarding follows the news (fuel x1.15, days 5-8). Unlike the port scenarios this removes a domestic source, not an entry point. Planned maintenance stops of two weeks are absorbed by product stocks and are not a crisis; see SOURCES.md.
